content.title: Masters Day 4 tee times: McIlroy and Lowry in last groups
content.text: Updated / Sunday, 12 Apr 2026 01:07 Rory McIlroy (R) and Cameron Young (L) will play together for the third time this week Rory McIlroy and Cam Young of the United States will be the last pairing out in Sunday's conclusion of the Masters with the pair teeing off at 7.25pm Irish time. Just ahead of them in Group 26 will be Offaly's Shane Lowry and Sam Burns of the United States at 7.14pm. McIlroy and Young share the lead after three rounds as the County Down man saw his six-shot halfway lead eroded away, with Burns one back and Lowry a shot further back on nine-under par. The final day action will begin at 2.06pm Irish time with England's Aaron Rai and former champion Charl Schwartzel getting proceedings underway at Augusta.
